\begin{document}

The survey of the river began in the spring, when the water was still high and the banks were soft underfoot.

\begin{tcolorbox}[colframe=blue!50!black, colback=white, arc=2mm, boxrule=0.9pt, left=1mm, right=1mm, top=2mm, bottom=2mm]
The surveyors walked the north bank first, marking each bend with a painted stake and noting the depth of the water at every
ford. By the end of the month they had mapped the river from the mill to the old stone bridge, and the map was pinned to the
wall of the inn where anyone could see it.
\end{tcolorbox}

\vspace{3cm}

In the summer the water fell, and the fords the surveyors had marked could be crossed on foot.

\end{document}
